ranks.title: Foundations
ranks.meaning: Knows the basic vocabulary and building blocks of the skill.
ranks.observable: Recognizes and recalls the core elements; completes guided exercises with scaffolding.

ranks.title: Basic application
ranks.meaning: Applies single ideas to standard, familiar tasks.
ranks.observable: Solves standard tasks that use one concept at a time, with light scaffolding.

ranks.title: Independent application
ranks.meaning: Works without help on ordinary tasks and finds their own mistakes.
ranks.observable: Produces correct work from a blank page and locates and fixes errors in given work.

ranks.title: Transfer
ranks.meaning: Handles unfamiliar variations and explains why one approach beats another.
ranks.observable: Solves problems framed in unfamiliar ways and justifies trade-offs between approaches.

ranks.title: Advanced problems
ranks.meaning: Combines several advanced concepts on problems nobody has walked them through.
ranks.observable: Solves hard, unfamiliar problems that combine several concepts, without hints.

ranks.title: Broad advanced mastery
ranks.meaning: Consistent advanced performance across the whole skill.
ranks.observable: Performs well on hard tasks drawn from anywhere in the graph and defends a project design.
ranks.trial: Hard tasks across the whole graph plus a project with a design defense.

ranks.title: Sustained mastery
ranks.meaning: Advanced mastery that has lasted and can be taught to others.
ranks.observable: Holds rank A for 90+ days with every retest passed, completes a capstone and a teach-back.
ranks.trial: Capstone and teach-back after 90 days at rank A.

competencies.name: Read all hiragana
competencies.mastery_criteria: Reads any hiragana word aloud without a chart.

competencies.name: Read all katakana
competencies.mastery_criteria: Reads katakana loanwords, including long vowels and small kana, without a chart.

competencies.name: Build polite sentences with desu and masu
competencies.mastery_criteria: Forms affirmative, negative and past polite sentences with desu and masu verbs.

competencies.name: Use the particles wa, ga, o, ni, de
competencies.mastery_criteria: Chooses the right basic particle in a sentence and explains the choice.
common_mistakes: confuses ni and de for location

competencies.name: Introduce yourself politely
competencies.mastery_criteria: Gives a 30-second self-introduction in polite form that a native listener understands.

competencies.name: Read N5 kanji
competencies.mastery_criteria: Reads and gives the meaning of the roughly 100 kanji listed for JLPT N5 in context.

competencies.name: Use the te-form
competencies.mastery_criteria: Conjugates verbs into the te-form and uses it for requests, sequences and ongoing actions.

competencies.name: Understand everyday conversations
competencies.mastery_criteria: Answers questions about short, slow everyday dialogues heard once.

competencies.name: Switch between plain and polite speech
competencies.mastery_criteria: Converts sentences between plain and polite forms and picks the register a situation needs.

competencies.name: Read short texts (N4 to N3)
competencies.mastery_criteria: Answers comprehension questions on short passages at JLPT N4 to N3 level.

competencies.name: Hold a simple conversation
competencies.mastery_criteria: Sustains a five-minute conversation on familiar topics, recovering from misunderstandings.

competencies.name: Use honorific and humble language
competencies.mastery_criteria: Uses sonkeigo and kenjougo correctly in workplace and service situations.

competencies.name: Produce natural pitch accent
competencies.mastery_criteria: Produces standard pitch accent on common words and phrases, as measured against native recordings.

competencies.name: Discuss abstract topics at native speed
competencies.mastery_criteria: Discusses abstract topics fluently with natural rhythm and intonation.

python.name: Python
python.scope: General-purpose Python 3 programming, from first scripts to idiomatic, tested code
python.ceiling_message: SHURA can verify Python all the way to Rank S.

sources.title: Introductory university programming course in Python (CS1) syllabus
Python Institute PCEP and PCAP exam syllabi

competencies.name: Values, variables and types
competencies.mastery_criteria: Predicts the type and value of expressions using int, float, str and bool, and assigns variables.

competencies.name: Branch with if, elif and else
competencies.mastery_criteria: Writes conditionals with comparison and boolean operators and predicts which branch runs.

competencies.name: Repeat with for and while loops
competencies.mastery_criteria: Writes for loops over ranges and sequences and while loops that terminate, using break and continue.

competencies.name: Define and call functions
competencies.mastery_criteria: Writes functions with parameters, default values and return values, and distinguishes return from print.

competencies.name: Work with lists and tuples
competencies.mastery_criteria: Indexes, slices, appends to and iterates over lists, and explains when a tuple fits better.

competencies.name: Work with dictionaries and sets
competencies.mastery_criteria: Counts, groups and looks up data with dicts and sets and picks the right structure for a task.

competencies.name: Manipulate strings
competencies.mastery_criteria: Uses split, join, strip, replace, f-strings and slicing to transform text.

competencies.name: Handle errors with exceptions
competencies.mastery_criteria: Reads tracebacks, catches specific exceptions with try/except/finally and raises meaningful errors.

competencies.name: Find and fix bugs in given code
competencies.mastery_criteria: Locates and fixes logic errors in unfamiliar functions of about 20 lines using tests and prints.

competencies.name: Read and write files
competencies.mastery_criteria: Reads and writes text and CSV files with context managers and handles missing files.

competencies.name: Organize code in modules and use the standard library
competencies.mastery_criteria: Splits code into modules, imports correctly and uses collections, itertools and pathlib.

competencies.name: Write comprehensions and generators
competencies.mastery_criteria: Rewrites loops as list, dict and set comprehensions and generators, and judges when a loop reads better.

competencies.name: Model data with classes
competencies.mastery_criteria: Writes classes with __init__, methods, properties and dataclasses, and explains composition versus inheritance.

competencies.name: Test code with pytest
competencies.mastery_criteria: Writes pytest tests that cover normal, edge and error cases for a given function.

competencies.name: Reason about performance
competencies.mastery_criteria: Estimates the time complexity of code and replaces quadratic patterns with suitable data structures.

competencies.name: Use closures, decorators and iterators
competencies.mastery_criteria: Writes closures, decorators and custom iterators and explains how they work.

competencies.name: Build a tested command-line tool
competencies.mastery_criteria: Delivers a small packaged CLI with tests and a README, and defends its design choices.

sql.name: SQL
sql.scope: Querying relational databases with standard SQL (PostgreSQL dialect), for data and backend roles
sql.ceiling_message: SHURA can verify SQL up to Rank B. Beyond that it guides your training but cannot certify it.

sources.title: PostgreSQL documentation: Tutorial and SQL Language chapters
Introductory university databases course syllabus (relational model, SQL, joins, aggregation)

competencies.name: Select columns from a table
competencies.mastery_criteria: Writes SELECT ... FROM ... returning the requested columns, including aliases with AS.
common_mistakes: quotes column names with single quotes

competencies.name: Filter rows with WHERE
competencies.mastery_criteria: Filters rows with comparison operators, AND, OR, IN, BETWEEN and LIKE.
common_mistakes: mixes AND and OR without parentheses

competencies.name: Sort and limit results
competencies.mastery_criteria: Orders results by one or more columns in either direction and limits the row count.

competencies.name: Handle NULL correctly
competencies.mastery_criteria: Uses IS NULL, IS NOT NULL and COALESCE and predicts how NULL behaves in comparisons.
common_mistakes: expects NULL = NULL to be true

competencies.name: Aggregate with COUNT, SUM, AVG, MIN, MAX
competencies.mastery_criteria: Computes aggregates over a whole table and predicts how COUNT(*) differs from COUNT(column).

competencies.name: Group rows with GROUP BY and HAVING
competencies.mastery_criteria: Groups rows, aggregates per group, and filters groups with HAVING rather than WHERE.

competencies.name: Join tables with INNER JOIN
competencies.mastery_criteria: Joins two or more tables on keys and qualifies ambiguous column names.

competencies.name: Keep unmatched rows with LEFT and FULL JOIN
competencies.mastery_criteria: Chooses between inner and outer joins and finds rows with no match using an outer join.
common_mistakes: filters the outer table in WHERE and turns the join back into an inner join

competencies.name: Use subqueries
competencies.mastery_criteria: Writes scalar, IN and EXISTS subqueries, including correlated ones.

competencies.name: Insert, update and delete rows
competencies.mastery_criteria: Writes INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE statements that affect exactly the intended rows.

competencies.name: Design tables with keys and constraints
competencies.mastery_criteria: Creates tables with suitable types, primary keys, foreign keys, NOT NULL and UNIQUE constraints.

competencies.name: Structure queries with CTEs
competencies.mastery_criteria: Rewrites nested queries as WITH clauses and writes a recursive CTE over a hierarchy.

competencies.name: Analyze with window functions
competencies.mastery_criteria: Uses ROW_NUMBER, RANK, LAG, LEAD and running totals with PARTITION BY and ORDER BY.
common_mistakes: confuses window functions with GROUP BY

competencies.name: Normalize a schema
competencies.mastery_criteria: Explains and applies first to third normal form and justifies deliberate denormalization.

competencies.name: Reason about transactions and isolation
competencies.mastery_criteria: Uses transactions correctly and predicts anomalies under each isolation level.

competencies.name: Speed up queries with indexes and EXPLAIN
competencies.mastery_criteria: Reads an EXPLAIN plan, chooses indexes that help a given workload, and explains the cost of each.
